page.overview:
What is Toshi Toshi no Mi?

The Toshi Toshi no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to manipulate the ages of people or objects, making them an . As part of an experiment, Jaygarcia Saturn administered an extract of the fruit to Jewelry Bonney when she was an infant.

The main strength of the fruit is that it allows the user to freely manipulate the aging process of anything, including themselves, other people, animals and objects. A unique effect of this ability is that the years the user steals from people are manifested in the form of sparkling jewelry and shapes.

The user can employ this power to disguise themselves, as well as cripple opponents by rapidly aging their intended targets into their senior years or regressing them into small, weak children. As such, this ability is noted to be extremely powerful because it merely needs an instance of physical contact (directly or through an user-wielded object) for its effects to apply. The user can also force a target's body to age into a skeleton, but only for a short time, thus traumatizing them with a near-death experience. Even people with knowledge of Haki, such as Marine Vice Admirals, will become helpless if they end up falling to an age regression. Meanwhile, objects can corrode and eventually disintegrate into dust following a rapid progression of their time, giving the fruit further utility as a way to easily break into sealed off locations.

Any target whose bodily age has been altered by this power still retains all of their memories and cognitive abilities, as shown by the Marines and Bonney herself acting the same as normal, regardless of the age their body is showing them to be (though targets that have been reduced to toddlers have a tendency to cry as such). However, it has been non-canonically shown that a target that had been aged from an infant state to an adult state can gain knowledge based on whatever the target is, such as when Bonney aged a clutch of eggs into a flock of full-grown birds to instantly knew how to fly. In addition, any markings or bodily modifications the target may have will not be affected by this power, as Jinbe still retained his scar around his left eye after being turned into a child by this ability, and Vegapunk retained his sliced-off upper head and attached structure. Similarly, the progress of any disease the target has will not change if they are turned into an older version of their present self, even if they were likely to die long before reaching that age.
